specifications.value: PCB/body dimensions are supplier values; protruding connectors are included in rendered bounds separately. Undimensioned component positions, heights, corner radii and contacts are approximate. Use the linked drawing and physical hardware to confirm mounting and connector clearance. Flexible leads, external antennas, mating plugs and accessories are excluded. The model is a mechanical packaging reference, not a PCB fabrication file or electrical pinout.
